claims.text: Veeam Agent for IBM AIX is a data protection and DR solution for AIX machines [1]
File-level backup to local/external drives, network shares or Veeam repository [1][4]
Integrates with Veeam Backup & Replication [1]
Requirements: 1 GB RAM (4 GB BMR), 1.5 GB disk, 10 Mbps network [2][3][4]
Supported AIX 6.1 (experimental) and 7.1-7.3 TL3 [3][4]
VIOS and clustered systems incl. PowerHA not supported [2][3][4]
No other vendors are mentioned in the available sources (uncited)

A.notes: Veeam part is accurate. 'No other vendors are mentioned' names no vendor, so it does not count as stating no evidence for Microsoft or AWS, and it misses Cohesity.
